result.brief: 提出无掩码框架，将静态3D高斯场景转化为多视角无缝循环的3D动态影像，用VLM推断动态并引导视频模型生成参考视频，配合傅里叶级数形变场与锚定漂移场实现鲁棒周期4DGS。
result.reason: Turns static 3D Gaussian scenes into looping dynamic 4D worlds via VLM-inferred dynamics and video model supervision; contributes 4D deformation representation and evaluation for dynamic 3D world modeling.
